zh.ledeLead: 整个页面的位移来自两条轨道的宽度：左栏
zh.ledeTail: ，中栏吃掉剩下的宽度。开合时中栏内容不是跳变，而是跟着轨道平滑重排。
zh.autoHint: 自动循环期间，两个手动开关先停用
zh.notesSourceTail: 五档为 100 / 150 / 200 / 300 / 350ms，340 与其中的 350ms 档最接近。左栏边界虚线停在原位，收起后可以直接读出中栏多吃了多少宽度。

en.ledeLead: The whole page's shift comes from two track widths: the left column
en.ledeTail: , and the middle column takes the remaining width. Open or close a panel and the middle column does not jump — its content reflows smoothly with the tracks.
en.toggleLeft: Open and close the left column
en.toggleRight: Open and close the right column
en.autoHint: While the auto loop runs, the two manual switches are disabled
en.guideCentre: Centre of the content when both sides are open
en.notesSourceAfter: in site.css); the five steps of
en.notesSourceTail: in 40-motion are 100 / 150 / 200 / 300 / 350 ms, and 340 sits closest to the 350 ms step. The dashed left column boundary stays where it was, so once the panel is closed you can read off how much extra width the middle column took.
